title: Self-Serving Bias
coreMove: Detect when the self-serving pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.
sourcePressure: The source sidecar and official source notes frame Self-Serving Bias as a specific decision error around self-serving, credit, blame. Traceable support includes Egocentric bias in availability and attribution.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Treating Self-Serving Bias as generic advice to be smarter, instead of forcing this exact move: detect when the self-serving pattern is tilting the evidence, then force the missing comparison before deciding.

hook: Do not open with a definition of Self-Serving Bias.
Do not use a generic panic-at-a-meeting opener.
counterintuition: Avoid the reusable shape where the obvious answer is wrong and the opposite is true.
Do not make Self-Serving Bias sound like ordinary carelessness.
examples: No coffee mug, classroom whiteboard, bus depot, radiator, bike helmet, or narrow kitchen shell.
No example may skip the specific mechanics of Self-Serving Bias.
